description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Oththapahuwa, Galnewa D/S Division, Anuradhapura District (25/0314)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement determining title to specific land parcels (Parcel Nos. 1:20 and 1:21) with detailed land particulars including owner names, extent, location, and encumbrances. The content falls under "PART III - LANDS" and involves land registration matters, which clearly fits the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category for land and property-related administrative matters.
